metadata.name: [GCP Cloud SQL PostgreSQL OTel] Disk utilization high
metadata.description: Alerts when the latest disk utilization of a PostgreSQL instance is at or above 90% of its disk quota for 2 consecutive checks. A full disk stops writes. Uses the latest per-minute value in a 15-minute window and the PostgreSQL engine marker. Grouped by database_id.

query.base:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
// Resolve each gauge per minute first (fragmentation-safe), then pick the latest minute.
| STATS disk_util = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`)),
        bytes_used = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)),
        quota = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)),
        pg = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/num_backends`))
    BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), database_id
// PostgreSQL engine marker: excludes MySQL / SQL Server instances that share these metrics
| INLINE STATS pg_total = SUM(pg) BY database_id
| WHERE pg_total > 0 AND disk_util IS NOT NULL
| STATS disk_util = LAST(disk_util, `@timestamp`),
        bytes_used = LAST(bytes_used, `@timestamp`),
        quota = LAST(quota, `@timestamp`)
    BY database_id
| EVAL disk_used_pct = ROUND(disk_util * 100.0, 1),
       free_gib = ROUND((quota - bytes_used) / 1073741824.0, 1)

data.content:
## Cloud SQL PostgreSQL disk utilization high

The instance is close to its disk quota. When the disk fills, the instance stops accepting writes.

### Triage
1. Check whether automatic storage increase is enabled. If not, increase the disk size now (it can only grow).
2. Find what is growing on the Instance Detail dashboard:
   - WAL retention: lagging read replicas or abandoned replication slots (check replica byte lag and `oldest_transaction_age` with type `replication_slot`).
   - Temp file spill: large sorts/hashes (`temp_bytes_written_count`).
   - Table and index bloat: vacuum blocked by long-running transactions.
3. Drop unused replication slots, end blocking transactions, and run VACUUM where bloat is the cause.

### Tuning
- Lower the threshold to 80 for an earlier warning. With automatic storage increase enabled, a high threshold catches the case where it cannot keep up.
